account_availability_month.name: account_availability_month
account_availability_month.value: (availability_from IS NULL OR extract(day from availability_from) = 1) AND (availability_to IS NULL OR extract(day from availability_to) = 1)

email_token_invite_fields.name: email_token_invite_fields
email_token_invite_fields.value: (purpose = 'org_invite') = (org_id IS NOT NULL AND invite_roles IS NOT NULL)

application_availability_month.name: application_availability_month
application_availability_month.value: (availability_from IS NULL OR extract(day from availability_from) = 1) AND (availability_to IS NULL OR extract(day from availability_to) = 1)

candidate_statement_channel_ref.name: candidate_statement_channel_ref
candidate_statement_channel_ref.value: (channel = 'agent' AND token_id IS NOT NULL) OR (channel = 'web' AND session_id IS NOT NULL)

requirement_signal_only_eligibility.name: requirement_signal_only_eligibility
requirement_signal_only_eligibility.value: category = 'eligibility' OR (signal_value IS NULL AND signal_basis IS NULL)

judgment_human_override.name: judgment_human_override
judgment_human_override.value: judge_kind <> 'human' OR reviewer_member_id IS NOT NULL

decision_reason_codes.name: decision_reason_codes
decision_reason_codes.value: cardinality(reason_codes) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND reason_codes <@ ARRAY['meets_must_haves', 'strong_evidence', 'strong_work_sample', 'strong_interview', 'requirements_not_shown', 'work_sample_below_bar', 'interview_below_bar', 'stronger_candidates_selected', 'no_response_to_requests', 'role_filled_or_closed', 'legal_eligibility_requirement', 'other_job_related', 'selected_for_offer', 'background_check_review', 'background_check_adverse', 'contingency_not_met', 'candidate_request', 'role_eliminated']::text[]

proposal_web_resolution.name: proposal_web_resolution
proposal_web_resolution.value: status NOT IN ('confirmed', 'declined') OR (resolved_session_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_by_member_id IS NOT NULL)

audit_event_actor.name: audit_event_actor
audit_event_actor.value:
CASE actor_kind
        WHEN 'person_agent' THEN actor_account_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_token_id IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'person_web' THEN actor_account_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_session_id IS NOT NULL
        ELSE actor_job IS NOT NULL
      END

notification_has_recipient.name: notification_has_recipient
notification_has_recipient.value: recipient_account_id IS NOT NULL OR to_email IS NOT NULL
